messages:
Ava (eng-platform): Heads up — p99 on the latency dashboard looks LOWER than p95 for the mobile cohort overlay. Seen in prod and staging. https://console.redwood.internal/dash/1234 :eyes:
Jon (eng-platform): whoa that's impossible mathematically. might be an aggregation/display bug. Can you grab the raw sample counts?
Ava (eng-platform): sample counts look normal per-route, here's the quick query I ran:
```sql
SELECT cohort, quantile, value, sample_count
FROM latency_samples
WHERE dash_id = 1234 AND ts >= now() - interval '1h'
ORDER BY cohort, quantile
```
Priya (platform-ds): hmm if the dashboard is merging tdigest sketches from client-side then re-quantiling we could see inversion due to compression. Client SDKs do a small sketch + weight, right? @Maya any recent changes to overlay code?
Maya (frontend): I only updated the cohort overlay coloring and legend. No aggregation logic touched. But the frontend requests /api/dash/1234?merge=client by default. I can flip to server-merge to test.
Jon (eng-platform): @Priya good point — tdigest merge order and compression delta can cause p99 < p95 especially on small sample buckets merged then downsampled. But our server merge path rehydrates raw latencies, doesn't it?
Priya (platform-ds): server-merge SHOULD rehydrate, but our service has a fast-path that accepts pre-merged sketches and just stores them. If the fast-path is ending up on the viz path without re-expansion, the UI could be re-merging already-compressed sketches.
Ava (eng-platform): I toggled the dashboard to server-merge (query param) and values normalized — p99 > p95 again. So root cause likely client-sketch merge on viz side.
Maya (frontend): thanks, that matches. Quick fix: change overlay request to force server_merge=true. I'll open a tiny PR.
Jon (eng-platform): Longer term we should: 1) document merge semantics in the console API 2) add a sanity check that rejects pctl inversions at render-time with a warning badge 3) add unit test to ensure sketch-merge idempotency.
Priya (platform-ds): Agreed. Also suggest emitting a telemetry tag when a cohort contains many tiny sketches (high fragment count) so we can alert before this surfaces.
Ava (eng-platform): Sounds good. @deploy-bot can we roll the UI patch to staging after CI?
deploy-bot: build passed — staging deploy queued for maya/force-server-merge (PR #4021). :rocket:
Maya (frontend): PR linked, adding the server_merge flag and a tiny tooltip explaining "client-side sketching may understate tail percentiles".
Jon (eng-platform): I'll create a short RFC for the API change and add the sanity badge mock. Priya, can you prototype the telemetry tag?
Priya (platform-ds): On it. I'll also run a simulated merge experiment to quantify how often this inversion shows up for <1k samples. Expect results by EOD. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Ava (eng-platform): Thanks team — great catch. Leaving the dashboard note so customers don't misinterpret the numbers: adding temporary banner explaining "p50/p95/p99 computed from server-merged data unless otherwise noted." :memo:
Maya (frontend): staging deck updated, will watch after deploy. :eyes:
